entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Jul 20, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Vacation of City Easements at 2415 Russell Avenue. Council held a public hearing and adopted an ordinance authorizing the vacation of City easements across private property at 2415 Russell Avenue (Tax Map No. 1420201) and amending Ordinance No. 43129-012125 to extend the deadline to complete certain conditions. Recorded vote: 7-0.

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Jul 6, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Amendments to Chapter 36.2 Zoning Code for Housing Development and Land Use. Following the continuation of a public hearing, the City Council adopted an ordinance and a resolution approving proposed amendments to Chapter 36.2 (Zoning) of the Code of the City of Roanoke. The amendments are intended to facilitate context-sensitive housing development, promote community health and wellness, encourage purposeful land use, update use tables for multiple purpose, industrial, and planned unit development districts, and clarify and correct zoning code elements. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6512,plainText=false)

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Jun 15, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Follow-Up on Evans Spring Preservation Concerns. The Inclusive Services Manager reported that Community Engagement reached out to two residents who voiced concerns on May 18 regarding Evans Spring preservation and zoning text amendments, but neither resident responded.
Adopted: Rezoning on Westside Boulevard NW and Shenandoah Avenue NW. Council adopted an ordinance approving the request of Cross Creek Development Corporation to rezone parcels on Westside Boulevard NW and Shenandoah Avenue NW from R-5 to RMF with conditions. Recorded vote: 6-0.
Adopted: Rezoning on Williamson Road NE and Forest Hill Avenue NE. Council adopted an ordinance approving the City's request to rezone parcels on Williamson Road NE and Forest Hill Avenue NE from CN, CG, and RM-1 to INPUD. Recorded vote: 6-0.

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Jun 1, 2026
entry.summary:
Hearing scheduled: Continuation of Public Hearing on Comprehensive Zoning Code Amendments. City Council voted 6-0 to continue the May 18 public hearing on proposed amendments to Chapter 36.2 (Zoning) to July 6, 2026, at 7:00 pm. The proposed amendments address context-sensitive housing development, community health and wellness, use tables for multiple purpose, industrial, and planned unit development districts, and zoning code clarifications. Recorded vote: 6-0.

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, May 18, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Donation of Parcels at 0 Hollins Road, N.E.. Council voted to adopt Ordinance No. 43393-051826 accepting a donation of privately owned parcels (Tax Map Nos. 3140815 and 3140819) situated at 0 Hollins Road, N.E. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Architectural Review Board Application Process and Backlog Clearance. City staff reported on planning discussions to expand the Architectural Review Board's role in evaluating Certificate of Appropriateness applications during public meetings, and announced that an administrative review backlog of 22 overdue applications was cleared between April 27 and May 9, 2026.
Adopted: Rezoning of 1007 3 1/2 Street SE. Following a public hearing, Council adopted Ordinance No. 43397-051826 to rezone 1007 3 ½ Street SE from Light Industrial District (I-1) to Urban Flex District (UF). Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Complete Streets Policy Updates and Comprehensive Plan Incorporation. Council adopted Ordinance No. 43398-051826 incorporating Complete Streets Policy updates and the Safety Action Plan/Speed Management Action Plan into City Plan 2040. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Evans Spring Plan Comprehensive Plan Amendments. Council approved Ordinance No. 43402-051826, as amended, adopting amendments to the Evans Spring Plan: A Comprehensive Guide for Development as part of City Plan 2040. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Deferred: Citywide Zoning Code Amendments (Chapter 36.2). A public hearing was held on proposed citywide amendments to Chapter 36.2 (Zoning) intended to promote context-sensitive housing, community health, and revise district use tables; City Council postponed the matter to a subsequent meeting.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6490,plainText=false)

entry.title: Land use & zoning · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Adopted: Rezoning of 0 Janette Avenue SW. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Ordinance No. 43486-101926, rezoning 0 Janette Avenue SW from Recreation and Open Space District (ROS) to Residential District (RM-2). Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Rezoning of Parcels at 0 Franklin Road SW. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Ordinance No. 43487-101926, approving the request of Lawson Company Incorporated to rezone three parcels at 0 Franklin Road SW from Mixed Use District (MX) to Residential District (RM-2). Recorded vote: 7-0.
Withdrawn: Proffer Repeal Request for 3509 Peters Creek Road NW. A public hearing request by Echo Sentinel Group, LLC, to repeal all conditions proffered in a previous rezoning at 3509 Peters Creek Road NW was withdrawn.
Adopted: Enterprise Zone One A Boundary Amendments. Following a public hearing, City Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43488-101926, approving boundary amendments to Enterprise Zone One A. Recorded vote: 7-0.
